LanguageData.BOR_OrientisChoiceText:
A great shadow looms over the Settlement. {0} feels a sick sensation in their chest, their limbs, their groin. Something that is both unfathomably dark --but so bright it feels like needles in their eyes -- blinds them. They lift their palm to shield their face, when a voice rumbles through the shadows. It sounds like a chorus, and surrounds {0}.

“For years, another Will has spoken through this Colony. Your Home. It has shaped your buildings. It has shaped your people. It may yet shape your future. But here you stand, on the edge of The Precipice. Only madness remains.

I give you a choice -- go down the dark path and lose yourself to the Dark Archotech's machinations, or turn away and embrace the light. Whatever you choose, there is no going back.”
LanguageData.BOR_OrientisLightBegins: The Light descends on the Settlement.
LanguageData.BOR_OrientisDoneText: The Tenebral influence has departed. Dark shrines crumble into inert stone and Umbral constructs fall away. Those released from the old bond awaken as Orientis, carrying with them a new, strange connection. There are many new abilities and strengths to discover, and {0} can now manifest Orientis Buildings into being.

It stops incoming projectiles, mortar fire and orbital bombardments, and burns tenebral and Umbral pawns inside: -35% consciousness at once, and 5% more every hour.\n\nAn Orientis pawn has to walk to the pod to raise it. It falls when the map runs out of meditation power.
